method.personal_share_formula: mean(consumption_mode_weight, command_scope_weight); only the ruler's accepted person result is consumed
method.C2_peak_formula: tier_score + 0.3*difficulty; the peak is bounded by the S+/D5 natural maximum of 7.5 and is not summed across battles
method.C2_grade_policy: hard-gate adjudication from peak, independent high-difficulty revalidation, sustained contexts, and defeat/failure caps; support results determine sufficiency but cannot overflow into a higher grade
method.C2_negative_policy: all in-window negative person results and primary command failures are consumed; same-group negative result and attributable failure are deduplicated
method.default_policy: evidence gap uses grade 0 LOW; documented no contribution uses grade 0 LOW
